description: CreateSecret refuses a second secret with the same name in the same path with a plain argument error, not the `already_exists` envelope the other APIs use. Observed 2026-10-14 in the live Project: `POST /secret-manager/v1beta1/regions/fr-par/secrets` twice with one name answered 400 `{"type":"invalid_arguments","message":"invalid argument(s)","details":[{"argument_name":"name","reason":"format","help_message":"cannot have same secret name in same path"}]}`. The error is typed here so a caller can tell it from a malformed request; it is categorised as a conflict (`httpError` 409), the way the SDK's `AlreadyExistsError` is, although the wire status is 400.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A secret with this name already exists in the same path.

message.includes: cannot have same secret name in same path
